# Apply Fixes

## Change Summary

No additional fixes were required in this pass. The latest approved implementation already documented the porous-media colonizable-area ceiling, added the explicit 25C pKa1 reference, attached provenance/confidence metadata to the previously uncovered shrimp condition, molt-stress, and NH3-stress tunables, updated docs/PROVENANCE_STATUS.md, and extended regression coverage to keep those annotations in place.

## Steps

0. [Completed] Reviewed the round-3 validation output and confirmed the review outcome was approved with no follow-up amendments.
1. [Skipped] Skipped further code and data edits because the approved implementation already satisfied the requested provenance fixes for the priority parameter families and the remaining gaps are documented as follow-up risk, not review blockers.
2. [Completed] Carried forward the current validation record from the approved implementation because no new changes were made in this pass.

## Validation Evidence

- No new validation was run in this pass because no new changes were required after review approval.
- Latest recorded implementation validation remains green: cargo fmt completed successfully.
- Latest recorded implementation validation remains green: cargo test -p tank_data passed with 38 tests green and 0 failures.
- Latest recorded review evidence also recorded tank_scenarios suites green, tank_core with 102 tests green, and clean clippy across tank_data, tank_scenarios, and tank_core.

## Outstanding Risks

- soft_acidic.toml and ro_like.toml still do not carry per-parameter param_meta entries.
- Substrate provenance coverage is still partial beyond representative colonizable_area_factor annotations; other substrate indices and nutrient-charge fields remain unannotated.
- Code-resident carbonate solver constants still rely on doc comments plus docs/PROVENANCE_STATUS.md until the project adds a dedicated metadata registry for shared chemistry constants.
